summary: Keep equal-digest replication answers compact across concurrent writes

replay.detail: No replay or recovery is required; exported inventory metadata changes only.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored claim changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, envelope admission and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Equal-digest answers retain existing range-digest fields instead of omitting them. Older peers already ignore these optional fields. No exchange body or metadata limit is raised. Explicit legacy full-inventory requests still receive the existing answer.

downtime.detail: Only the ordinary binary upgrade restart is required; restart duration was not measured.

manual.detail: Upgrade normally; there is no state migration or manual repair.

recovery.detail: An older binary can read the unchanged state and restores the previous inventory export behavior.
